_comment: New pages for utils/design/sheets.json. Same shape as the existing file. MaterialSheetCatalogue.{h,cpp} is GENERATED from that file by utils/generate_sheet_catalogue.mjs — never hand-edited. Re-run the generator so a transcription can be diffed rather than trusted.

pages.title: Regex builder
pages.blurb: Reachable from every search bar in the application.

rows.name: Dialect
rows.value: QRegularExpression (PCRE2). The prototype executes ECMAScript RegExp and says so on the Dialects tab.

rows.name: Bounds
rows.value: Pattern 512 chars, sample 20 000 chars, 120 ms evaluation budget, 500 matches. Nested-quantifier shapes are flagged before the run.

rows.name: Return path
rows.value: The accepted pattern goes back to the bar that opened the builder, never unconditionally to the vault.

rows.name: Unicode properties
rows.value: \p{…} needs the u flag in JS and UseUnicodePropertiesOption in Qt.

rows.name: Replacement syntax
rows.value: Qt uses \1 and \g<name> in QString::replace(); JS uses $1 and $<name>.

pages.title: External editor
pages.blurb: Open the database folder or a selected file in your editor.

rows.name: Detection
rows.value: Scans the usual install paths; anything not found is shown as not found rather than silently omitted.

rows.name: Degradation
rows.value: With no editor configured the action explains what is missing instead of doing nothing.

rows.name: Keyboard
rows.value: Every control reachable, with a visible focus ring and a sensible tab order.

rows.name: Contrast
rows.value: Every foreground/background pair in the token set meets 4.5:1 for body text.

rows.name: Motion
rows.value: prefers-reduced-motion is honoured automatically, and there is an explicit toggle beside it.

rows.name: Clipping
rows.value: No clipped or overlapping text at any of the five breakpoints, three densities or three language modes.
